name: xiaohei-infographic
title_zh: 小黑手绘风信息图，一篇笔记变一张可发朋友圈的长图
tagline_zh: 文章、推文、大纲丢进去，出来是纯白底、真手绘感的高清长图。不用会设计，不用找模板，发微信、小红书都够清晰。
tagline_en: Drop in an article or outline, get a high-DPI, hand-drawn-style long image. No design skills or templates.
desc_en: Create Xiaohei-style Chinese infographics and knowledge cards from articles, notes, tweets, outlines, or structured content. Use when the user asks for 信息图, 知识卡片, 长图, visual summary, shareable image, WeChat/social media card, or wants to combine Ian 小黑 hand-drawn illustration style with infographic structure. Produces one high-DPI PNG shareable long image: pure white background, real hand-drawn Xi
why_zh: 不是套模板拼框，而是按内容结构重排信息层级，再叠小黑手绘笔触。产物是单张 PNG，直接能发。
why_en: It reflows your content hierarchy, then applies Xiaohei's hand-drawn strokes—not a template collage. Output is one.
limit_zh: 只认中文内容，且输入需为结构化文本（文章/笔记/大纲/推文），不处理纯图片或 PDF。产物是单张竖版长图。
limit_en: Chinese text only; input must be structured (article/note/outline/tweet). No images or PDFs. Output is one vertical long image—no multi-page docs.
title_en: Turn notes into shareable Xiaohei-style infographic PNGs
